transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm just here because I've been worrying a lot lately. Just... about everything, really. Work, mostly. Clients, the housing market... my family. Money. Even just little things, like if moving to our new condo was the right choice. It just... it feels like it's too much, you know? Like I'm worrying more than I should be.
How often do you feel this worry throughout the day, and does it tend to follow you even when you're not at work or dealing directly with those situations?

Well... yes, it does follow me. It's... a lot of the day, I suppose. 

I do try to reason with myself when I'm not at work. I'll tell myself, 'Parin, this is not urgent.' But... I don't know. One concern just sort of leads to another. And before I know it, I’ve spent half an hour just... replaying small details I meant to let go.
When you're feeling this worry, do you also notice any physical symptoms like muscle tension, restlessness, or trouble sleeping?

Well... I suppose my neck and shoulders get a bit tight. By the end of the day, it just feels like I've been bracing myself. And... sometimes I catch myself clenching my jaw while I'm driving between listings, or sitting at my desk. I don't know... I guess that's mostly what I notice.
Have you been feeling this way—experiencing a lot of worry and anxiety— more days than not for at least the past six months?
Yes... longer than six months, I suppose. It's been... maybe about a year and two months now. Just... right after I sold my old house and moved into the condo.
Do you find it hard to control the worrying, even when you know the concerns aren't that serious or realistic?

I suppose... yes. Like I mentioned earlier, it's just difficult to stop it once it starts. I try to tell myself it isn't urgent, but... it doesn't really work. My mind just keeps jumping to the next thing, and... I still end up stuck on those little details anyway.
Has this worry started to affect your daily life, like making it hard to focus on tasks, causing you to avoid certain situations, or impacting your performance at work or relationships at home?

Well... I suppose it's mostly just at work. Um... even straightforward things, like listing negotiations or going over contracts... they're just taking me a lot longer than they used to. And... I guess I've been delaying returning some client calls lately. I just... I don't always feel confident that I've checked everything carefully enough yet, so... I put it off. That's really all I've noticed.
Do you find yourself avoiding any particular situations, places, or activities because you feel anxious or worried about what might happen?
No, not really. I just... go to work and come home. I haven't stopped doing anything.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about a variety of things, not just specific situations or events?

I suppose so. It's... well, it's why I made the appointment, really. It just seems like I worry about everything lately. Um... my clients, the housing market, my family... money. Even just... whether selling the house and moving to the condo was the right choice. It's just... a lot of things, and I know it's probably out of proportion to what's actually going on, but... yes. It's a lot of different things.
Have you noticed any days where you feel down, sad, or hopeless, or if you're losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
No, not really. I don't... I don't feel sad or hopeless. I still like doing the things I usually do. It's just the worrying.
Have you experienced or been through any particularly stressful or traumatic event recently that you find yourself thinking about or affected by?
No. Nothing like that. I haven't been through anything traumatic. Just... normal life stuff, really.
Have you noticed feeling more irritable or fatigued lately because of all the worrying?
I don't think so. I mean... maybe a little tired, but nothing out of the ordinary. And I wouldn't say I'm irritable. Just... preoccupied, I guess.
Have you ever experienced sudden episodes where you feel intense fear or discomfort that peaks within minutes, like a panic attack?
No... I don't think so. I haven't had anything like that. It's not really a sudden thing, just... the constant worrying.
Have you ever tried to push away or avoid thinking about your worries, or tried to distract yourself to keep from feeling anxious?

Not really. I don't... go out of my way to push them out of my head or anything. I just keep busy with work, I suppose. But I wouldn't say I'm actively trying to distract myself. They're just sort of... there.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried specifically about being judged or evaluated by others, such as during presentations, meetings, or even just talking with clients?
No... not really. I talk to clients every day, it's just what I do. I don't really focus on them judging me or anything like that.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried specifically about being away from home or being separated from family members?
No, I don't think so. I'm fine being away from home. It's... just normal life.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried specifically about being separated from your children, spouse, or other close family members, even when they’re just going to work or school?
No. Like I said, I'm fine being away from them. It's just a normal part of the day.
Have you noticed yourself feeling persistently on edge, easily startled, or constantly anticipating something bad happening, even when there’s no clear reason for it?
No, I wouldn't say so. I don't... I'm not easily startled or anything like that. I just go about my business.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried specifically about being away from your home or being separated from your family members, even when you know they're safe and just going about their day?
I... didn't we just talk about this? No. I'm fine being away from the house. I work in real estate, so I'm out a lot anyway. It really isn't an issue for me.
